subject: Post-demo qualification: grounding thresholds, reranker options & eval pack
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@lucentrx.com>; Victor Hale <victor.hale@lucentrx.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo qualification: grounding thresholds, reranker options & eval pack

Hi Claire / Victor —

Thanks again for taking the product demo today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can qualify for a short pilot: 

1) Model fit ask:
- Primary workload: clinician-facing Q&A and note summarization where hallucination avoidance is critical.
- Your success metric: >95% grounding precision on the 200-probe suite (precision = fraction of model answers correctly grounded to internal documents).

2) RAG configuration we recommend to start: 
- Retriever: dense ANN over the LucentRx KB (FAISS HNSW, vectors @768 dim).
- Retriever window: top_k=25 non-filtered, downstream reranker to trim to top5.
- Reranker: pairwise cross-encoder for high-precision ranking (we recommend the Redwood-verified re-ranker profile 'rwrk-medium-v2').

3) Models we propose for the pilot (two parallel arms):
- Arm A (safety-first): redwood-7b-guarded-q  — lower latency, stronger calibration, uses conservative decoding + grounding penalty.
- Arm B (quality-first): redwood-13b-finetuned — higher throughput cost, better abstractive answers.

4) Eval pack + probes:
- I attached the LucentRx evaluation probe CSV (200 probes) and our suggested prompt set (in the Drive link).
- We'll run benchmark runs for both arms and return token-level latency + grounding precision/recall.

5) Next steps / asks from LucentRx:
- Can your team share a short sample of the KB (redacted) and a set of 30 high-priority queries by Wed 6/16?
- Confirm whether procurement should be looped now (we can send a lightweight SOW + pilot terms).

I've attached my quick post-call notes and the Redwood eval playbook v2 for reference. Proposed internal owners: Aditya (inference config + reranker selection), Jasmine (eval runs + metrics).

Thanks — I can get a tailored benchmark matrix back by EOD next Thursday if we get the samples.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: neha_postcall_notes.pdf, redwood_eval_playbook_v2.md, lucentrx_rag_eval_probe.csv

Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 
- We can provide a redacted KB sample (PDF + text dump) and the 30 queries by EOD 6/16. Victor will own the data drop.
- Procurement: procurement@lucentrx.com — please send the SOW/terms; we prefer a 30-day pilot agreement with a small usage cap.

Two concerns I want to flag up-front: 
1) Latency for clinician flows needs to stay <400ms median for short Q&A (we understand this pushes towards smaller models or aggressive caching).
2) Regression sensitivity — we need a process to detect quality regressions after any model switch. Can your eval pack include a regression alert threshold and suggested rollback policy?

Thanks — Claire
Claire Barnes
Head of Product, LucentRx

Thanks — Claire

Claire / Victor — quick technical notes from my side: 
- Latency: we can meet ~350–450ms median for redwood-7b-guarded-q in a dedicated config with prefix caching and batching limits tuned to p95=8 concurrent session concurrency; redwood-13b will likely be around 650–900ms unless we pin to Dedicated with faster GPU types.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for the typical clinician prompt templates — that reduces per-request compute and helps with tail latency.
- Regression detection: we will include these in the eval pack: 
  * Golden probe set (200 items) run on both arms and baseline model — report precision/recall and per-probe diff.
  * Regression alert: delta_precision_drop > 3% across the golden set triggers canary rollback.
  * Automated daily sampling: run 50 random production-like queries against pinned model and record grounding score distribution; if p50 or p95 degrade by configured thresholds, send an alert.

Attachments in this thread: lucentrx_rag_eval_probe.csv (probe set), redwood_eval_playbook_v2.md (playbook). I'll prepare the initial eval config JSON and upload to the Drive link tomorrow morning.
